basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer based in New York City, juggling a day job as a software developer with my love for gaming. I enjoy playing NBA 2K on my PS5, especially team-based modes like Park and Rec. When I'm not gaming, I dabble in music production and occasionally release tracks through DistroKid. I enjoy a good laugh, which explains my frequent visits to humor subreddits like ShittyCurses. I usually log on to Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to game and explore different hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in software development, having learned programming through a Computer Science degree and several years of hands-on work experience. My gaming expertise comes from years of playing competitively in various online games, self-teaching strategies, and staying updated with gaming communities.
